# Fixed list for scripts/search_quality.mjs (see README.md, "Search quality"). Needs a build that has the AWS SSO
# task page (guide/user/integrations/aws-sso, on agent-fleet main since #3566; not in v0.41.0).
複数のプロファイルを使う
ログインが切れたとき
# 共有サインイン / shared sign-in allow 5: the word is only in the body of the aws-sso page, while the chapters
# operate/05-signin and user/team/share and the reference ref/aws-profiles (heading 「共有サインイン」) match it
# more directly. Tightening these to 3 needs a heading in the guide (see the PR for #3574).
# shared sign-in allows 8: the operate task pages (secure/dev-signin, signin/*) carry "sign-in" in their titles
# and rank above the expected page for the bare words; the specific query 「共有ログイン」 still holds at 3.
# The bare word "deploy" matches nearly every operate page, so it is not a query: "choose where to deploy" and
# 「デプロイ先」 ask for the choosing page, and "deploy on ECS" for the ECS install page (the runbook index is
# only a table of contents now).
# AWS プロファイル allows 5: af-aws-exec, aws-sso and the new aws-emulator page all say 「AWS プロファイル」 often and rank above the reference page.
# ログインが切れたとき allows 5: the agents' troubleshooting page and the Codex / Claude pages answer "the login expired" for agent sign-in, and rank above the AWS SSO page once the old chapters are gone.
